# routeros_ovpn_server_instance (Resource)
One named OVPN server (`/interface/ovpn-server/server`) on RouterOS 7.17+, where the menu is a list. On older versions use `routeros_ovpn_server` (one system setting). Not to be confused with `routeros_interface_ovpn_server` (static per-user interface bindings in `/interface/ovpn-server`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Server name, e.g. `ovpn-server1`.

### Optional

- `auth` (Set of String) Authentication (HMAC) methods that the server accepts.
- `certificate` (String) Name of the certificate the server presents.
- `cipher` (Set of String) Allowed data channel ciphers.
- `comment` (String)
- `default_profile` (String) PPP profile for users whose secret does not name one.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `enable_tun_ipv6` (Boolean) Whether IPv6 can be tunnelled in `ip` mode.
- `ipv6_prefix_len` (Number) Length of the IPv6 prefix of the server-side interface.
- `keepalive_timeout` (String) Seconds of silence after which the router starts sending keepalives; a client that stays silent for twice this time is disconnected. `disabled` turns keepalive off.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the server (generated when not set; used in `ethernet` mode).
- `max_mtu` (Number) Largest packet the OVPN interface sends without fragmentation.
- `mode` (String) `ip` (layer 3, tun) or `ethernet` (layer 2, tap).
- `netmask` (Number) Prefix length pushed to the client with its address.
- `port` (Number) Listening port (TCP or UDP, see `protocol`).
- `protocol` (String) Transport: `tcp` or `udp`.
- `push_routes` (Set of String) IPv4 routes pushed to the client, e.g. `192.168.0.0/24` or `192.168.0.0 255.255.255.0`.
- `push_routes_ipv6` (Set of String) IPv6 routes pushed to the client.
- `redirect_gateway` (Set of String) redirect-gateway flags sent to the client: `def1` (0.0.0.0/1 + 128.0.0.0/1 through the tunnel), `ipv6` (2000::/4 + 3000::/4), or `disabled`.
- `reneg_sec` (Number) Renegotiate the data channel key every n seconds.
- `require_client_certificate` (Boolean) Accept only clients whose certificate is signed by the chain of the server certificate.
- `tls_version` (String) Allowed TLS versions: `any` or `only-1.2`.
- `tun_server_ipv6` (String) IPv6 prefix of the server-side interface in `ip` mode.
- `user_auth_method` (String) How the user name and password are checked (`pap`, `mschap2`).
- `vrf` (String) The VRF table this resource operates on.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
